`final class ProfileGlBinding`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3.snapshot` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [ProfileGlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/snapshot/ProfileGlBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Wraps an OpenGL binding so that the context looks like a snapshot profile: hidden extensions and an older GLSL version.

- [OpenGL profiles](/build/backends/lwjgl3/#opengl-profiles)

### from

`IGlBinding from(IGlBinding binding, SnapshotProfile profile)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>
